subject.title: fix(reply): add per-hook timeout in combineBeforeDeliverHooks to prevent lane deadlock (#103684)

question: Should 30 seconds become the shared cancellation deadline for every channel-provided `beforeDeliver` hook composed by core?
rationale: The shared composer currently has no documented deadline, and this change silently turns every over-budget hook into a cancelled message while the timed-out hook may continue running.

options.title: Adopt shared deadline
options.body: Make 30 seconds the documented core contract and require timer cleanup, late-hook semantics, deterministic tests, and live recovery proof.

options.title: Use owner-specific deadlines
options.body: Move timeout policy to the channel or hook owner that can define its valid budget and side-effect behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared deadline
recommendation.body: Make 30 seconds the documented core contract and require timer cleanup, late-hook semantics, deterministic tests, and live recovery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history most strongly connects him to the shared reply-dispatch lifecycle where this contract belongs.
